evidence.label: robots.txt
evidence.detail: FAIL: There is no robots.txt (HTTP 404). Fix: Serve a plain-text /robots.txt (RFC 9309) with at least one User-agent group and a Sitemap line.

evidence.label: Content Signals
evidence.detail: WARN: No robots.txt, so there's nowhere to declare Content Signals. Fix: Add a Content-Signal line to robots.txt (for example `Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no`) to state how AI systems may use your content.

evidence.label: Content Without JavaScript
evidence.detail: WARN: Homepage: 156 characters of text and 0 headings in the server HTML. 1 of 1 pages have little or no text or headings without JavaScript. Fix: Server-render your main content. Most AI crawlers don't run JavaScript, so a client-rendered

evidence.label: Markdown via Accept Header
evidence.detail: FAIL: No sampled page serves markdown when asked with `Accept: text/markdown` (1 page checked). Fix: Return a markdown version of each page when a request sends `Accept: text/markdown`, with `Vary: Accept` so caches keep the two apart.

evidence.label: Markdown at .md URLs
evidence.detail: FAIL: No sampled page serves markdown at a `.md` URL (1 page checked). Fix: Serve each page's markdown at the same path with `.md` appended (and `/index.md` for the homepage).

evidence.label: llms.txt
evidence.detail: FAIL: /llms.txt returned HTTP 404 with an HTML page. Fix: Publish /llms.txt as described at llmstxt.org: an H1 with the site name, a `>` summary, and sections of annotated markdown links.

evidence.label: llms-full.txt
evidence.detail: WARN: /llms-full.txt returned HTTP 404. Fix: Publish /llms-full.txt with the full text of your key pages or docs in one markdown file.

evidence.label: Sitemap
evidence.detail: FAIL: No valid sitemap at https://example.com/sitemap.xml (HTTP 404). Fix: Publish an XML sitemap listing your canonical pages, and reference it from robots.txt with a Sitemap line.

evidence.label: Discovery Link Headers
evidence.detail: WARN: The homepage sends no discovery Link header. Fix: Add an HTTP Link header (RFC 8288) to the homepage pointing at your sitemap, llms.txt (`rel="describedby"`), and markdown alternate.

evidence.label: Organization Structured Data
evidence.detail: FAIL: The homepage has no Organization JSON-LD. Fix: Add Organization JSON-LD to the homepage with name, url, logo, description, and contactPoint or address.

evidence.label: Entity Links (sameAs)
evidence.detail: FAIL: The Organization has no sameAs links. Fix: List your official profiles (LinkedIn, GitHub, Crunchbase, Wikipedia, X) in the Organization's `sameAs`, so models tie your site to the right entity.

evidence.label: Page Structured Data
evidence.detail: FAIL: Sampled pages have no content-level structured data. Fix: Mark up pages with the schema.org type that fits them: Article or BlogPosting, Product or SoftwareApplication, FAQPage, HowTo, BreadcrumbList.

headline: Example Domain lacks core content, structured data, and crawl files for AI assistants.

findings.title: Almost no readable content or headings
findings.why: The homepage has only 27 words and zero H1 headings, giving AI almost nothing to read or understand.
findings.fix: Add clear headings and full server-rendered text explaining what the business is and offers.

findings.title: Missing structured data and entity links
findings.why: There is no JSON-LD, Organization schema, sameAs links, or meta description for AI to identify the business entity.
findings.fix: Add Organization JSON-LD with sameAs links, content schema, and a meta description.

findings.title: Missing crawl and AI discovery files
findings.why: There is no robots.txt, sitemap, llms.txt, or Link header to guide AI crawlers to pages.
findings.fix: Publish robots.txt with Content Signals, an XML sitemap, and an llms.txt file.

findings.title: No prices, contact details, or structured dates
findings.why: The page lacks prices, contact information, and structured publish dates that make a source worth quoting.
findings.fix: Add visible pricing, contact details, and datePublished and dateModified in JSON-LD.

findings.title: No markdown endpoints or WebMCP tools
findings.why: The site does not serve markdown via Accept headers or .md URLs and declares no WebMCP tools.
findings.fix: Serve markdown alternatives for pages and declare WebMCP tools if agents should act on the site.

strengths.title: Lightweight page with minimal DOM and scripts
No third-party origins loaded on the page
